title: Research Borderlands: Analysing Writing Across Research Cultures

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs' ability to adapt research paper introductions to the specific structural, stylistic, and rhetorical norms of different scientific communities (e.g., NLP, HCI, ML), using a suite of computational metrics to compare LLM outputs against human-written baselines.

Measuring the tendency of LLMs to apply uniform stylistic changes (e.g., universally shortening text, reducing readability, or decreasing mentions of figures) regardless of the actual stylistic norms and expectations of the target community.
